title: Production checkout deletes saved payment methods
description: After a successful checkout, all saved payment methods disappear from the customer profile. The event is reproducible on production and causes permanent data loss.
stack_trace: DataIntegrityError: payment_method rows deleted during checkout finalization

title: Help icon is misaligned on profile page
description: The small help icon sits two pixels below its label in the profile settings page. No user workflow is blocked.

title: Mobile Safari login button does not respond to taps
description: On an iPhone using Safari, users enter valid login credentials but tapping the Sign in button does not submit the form or send an authentication request.

title: Checkout fails for carts over 10,000 dollars
description: Customers cannot pay for orders when the cart total exceeds $10,000. Checkout terminates with an unhandled validation exception before payment is processed.
stack_trace: ValidationError: total_amount must be below configured threshold

title: Product image overlaps Add to Cart control on tablet
description: On tablet-sized screens, the product gallery overlaps the Add to Cart control. A screenshot is included for visual analysis.
